desc: Archipelago's connection as Linux and macOS make it (0.5.0 report: a Linux player got no connection to archipelago.gg at all, its rooms being wss://, which only Windows had): Mbed TLS's socket (TTYD_AP_SOCKET=mbedtls; the one every platform but Windows uses) and an address without ws:// or wss:// (as archipelago.gg:PORT is typed), to a local stand-in server (tools/port/ap_standin_server.py, plain ws://): wss:// is tried first and fails, ws:// connects, and the slot is joined. No TTYD AP mod (TTYD_NO_MODS, no TTYD_AP_NO_MOD): the log says plainly that nothing is sent or received without it, instead of a connection that looks fine
log_must: archipelago: no enabled code mod looks like the TTYD AP mod \(Mods tab\): it gives the items and runs the checks, so nothing is sent or received without it
